patch_description: The previous pure-SLSQP version scored 0.98 while the current hybrid scored 0.93, so the repulsion stage's candidates may not feed SLSQP as good starting basins, and the SLSQP polish is under-converged. Improvements: (1) run SLSQP in a restart loop — after each converged run, re-run SLSQP starting from the previous solution with tighter ftol, which typically climbs out of the flat soft-min plateau near the optimum; (2) evaluate the true ratio (dmin/dmax) for every polished result and keep the global best, including comparing against the repulsion candidates themselves; (3) slightly increase repulsion iterations for better candidate quality. This adds moderate runtime but stays well below the timeout (previous 7.36s version was acceptable).
